title: ybx1 acts upstream of atoh1a to promote the rapid regeneration of hair cells in zebrafish lateral-line neuromasts.
authors: Reagor, Caleb C; Bravo, Paloma; Hudspeth, A J
one_liner_zh: 该文用监督学习算法DELAY推断斑马鱼侧线神经丘毛细胞再生的基因调控网络，发现ybx1通过结合atoh1a启动子DNA基序促进再生，涉及蛋白-DNA结合但非TF-DNA三维互作建模，方法为AI网络推断而非结构模拟。
abstract: Like the sensory organs of the human inner ear, the lateral-line neuromasts (NMs) of fish such as the zebrafish (Danio rerio) contain mechanosensory hair cells (HCs) that are surrounded by supporting cells (SCs). A damaged NM can quickly regenerate new HCs by expressing genes such as atoh1a, the master regulator of HC fate, in the SCs at the NM's center. We used the supervised learning algorithm DELAY to infer the early gene-regulatory network for regenerating central SCs and HCs and identified adaptations that promote the rapid regeneration of lateral-line HCs in larval zebrafish. The top hub in the network, Y-box binding protein 1 (ybx1), is highly expressed in HC progenitors and young HCs and its protein can recognize DNA-binding motifs in cyprinids' candidate regeneration-responsive promoter element for atoh1a. We showed that NMs from ybx1 mutant zebrafish larvae display consistent, regeneration-specific deficits in HC number and initiate both HC regeneration and atoh1a expression 20% slower than in wild-type siblings. By demonstrating that ybx1 promotes rapid HC regeneration through early atoh1a upregulation, the results support DELAY's ability to identify key temporal regulators of gene expression.
abstract_zh: 与人类内耳的感觉器官类似，斑马鱼（Danio rerio）等鱼类的侧线神经丘（NMs）含有机械感觉毛细胞（HCs），这些细胞被支持细胞（SCs）所包围。受损的神经丘能通过在其中心的支持细胞中表达诸如atoh1a（毛细胞命运的主调控因子）等基因，快速再生新的毛细胞。我们使用监督学习算法DELAY来推断再生中心支持细胞和毛细胞的早期基因调控网络，并识别出促进斑马鱼幼鱼侧线毛细胞快速再生的适应性变化。网络中的首要枢纽节点——Y-box结合蛋白1（ybx1），在毛细胞祖细胞和幼年毛细胞中高表达，其蛋白能识别鲤科鱼类中候选的再生响应启动子元件中atoh1a的DNA结合基序。我们证明，来自ybx1突变体斑马鱼幼鱼的神经丘在毛细胞数量上表现出一致且再生特异性的缺陷，并且毛细胞再生和atoh1a表达的启动速度比野生型同胞慢20%。通过证明ybx1通过早期上调atoh1a促进毛细胞快速再生，这些结果支持了DELAY识别基因表达关键时间调控因子的能力。
